description: This file defines an abstract base class for versioned persistence tests of a thing search service. It uses parameterized testing to run tests with different JSON schema versions and sets up the test data accordingly.

classes.name: AbstractVersionedThingSearchPersistenceITBase
classes.description: An abstract test class for verifying versioned persistence of thing search operations, parameterized over schema version.

methods.name: apiVersions
methods.description: Returns a list of all supported JSON schema versions for testing.

methods.name: versionAndQueryClassParameters
methods.description: Provides parameters for parameterized tests, pairing each API version with the string 'Query'.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up test data before each test, depending on the API version.

methods.name: createTestDataV1
methods.description: Abstract method to create test data for version 1.

methods.name: createTestDataV2
methods.description: Abstract method to create test data for version 2.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the API version being tested.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Creates a new Query object from given criteria.

methods.name: executeVersionedQuery
methods.description: Executes a versioned query based on search criteria, selecting the query method based on the query class string.
